T: So long, partner. Pass the snacks.
D: Andy's toys end up at a daycare centre run by a bear who smells of strawberries.
P: Serve dessert when the toys meet the strawberry-scented bear.
S: when the potato toy has to borrow a tortilla for a body
Flour tortillas filled with cheddar and Monterey Jack, folded, cooked in a dry pan until golden and melted, cut into wedges. Salsa.
Crisp apple slices tossed in lemon, cubes of mild cheddar, butter crackers and little cups of sultanas, set out in a muffin tin so everyone grabs their own.
the tea party in Bonnie's room
Fairy bread cut into triangles and crustless strawberry jam sandwiches cut into hearts with a cutter, laid out on a toy-sized tea set.
M: Spaghetti and meatballs: beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
Chicken thighs rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and salt, grilled until charred, sliced and wrapped in warm tortillas with cos, tomato, cheddar and a buttermilk ranch dressing.
W: the bear who smells of strawberries
Buttery shortcake rounds baked at 200C for 15 minutes, split and filled with whipped cream and strawberries macerated in sugar.
K: Ripe strawberries blended with cold milk, a spoon of honey and a few ice cubes until pink and frothy.

s.note: when the potato toy has to borrow a tortilla for a body
s.how: Fill 8 flour tortillas with 150g cheddar and 150g Monterey Jack, fold and cook in a dry pan until golden and melted. Cut into wedges. Dice 2 tomatoes with red onion and coriander for salsa.
Slice 2 apples and toss in lemon. Cube 150g mild cheddar. Fill the cups of a muffin tin with apple, cheese, butter crackers and little piles of sultanas so everyone grabs their own.

m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with 40g parmesan and parsley. Roll into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes. Toss with 500g spaghetti and more parmesan, and save a plate for the toys.

w.note: the bear who smells of strawberries
w.how: Rub 80g butter into 250g self-raising flour, stir in 150ml milk and pat out. Cut 4 rounds and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Toss 400g sliced strawberries with 2 tbsp sugar. Split the shortcakes and fill with 300ml whipped cream and the berries.

d.how: Blend 250g strawberries with 1L cold milk, 2 tbsp honey and a few ice cubes until pink and frothy. Pour into four glasses. Smells like strawberries.
